relevance_note: Case report of a man with Blau syndrome carrying NOD2 M513T ('the patient had early-onset BS at the age of 2 years, and the M513T mutation in the NOD2 was identified'), plus four previously reported BS patients with lung involvement and individual-level details in the Discussion.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. Scope: the first-hand patient (label 'patient', rule 5) plus four previously reported BS patients with pulmonary lesions listed in the Discussion with sex, age and NOD2 variant. Two of these ('a two-years-old and 7 months boy ... R334Q' and 'a two-years-old boy with R334W') have no printed reference, so they are labelled 'unnamed person 1' and 'unnamed person 2' (rule 6) and source_reference_in_review is 'not reported'. The 16-year-old male with R334 Q (3) is treated as the same person as 'another 16-years-old BS case' (3) and as the 2007 interstitial lung disease case (3), since all cite ref (3) with the same age; the ILD link is an inference from the shared reference. Ages of literature patients are recorded as age at last evaluation (age at time of their report). Contradiction: the Case presentation says 'a 22-years-old man' but the Discussion says 'a nineteen-year-old male of this presenting with M513T'; 22 was recorded. The patient's NOD2 variant is stated to have been previously reported (ref 2, Matsuda 2020). Zygosity and inheritance are not stated for any person. 'amino acid substitution Glu498Gly' recorded as variant type missense. Variants R334Q, R334W, L489F listed as 'not' carried by the ref (6) patient get no rows. Normal findings (leukocytes, spirometry, auscultation, BALF CD4/8 ratio) recorded as excluded abnormalities per D-27. Body temperature 36.3°C on admission was not called normal by the paper, so fever is left not reported. Pulmonary granulomas in the patient were not called interstitial lung disease by the paper, so that checklist item is left not reported for him. Elevated ACE, sIL-2R and MMP-3 are not ESR/CRP, so the inflammatory-marker checklist item is not reported. Vasculitis appears only in a differential diagnosis and is not recorded. The ref (6) case report 'recommended the use of prednisolone and immunosuppressive agents'; this is a recommendation, not a stated treatment, so treatment is not reported for that person.
